covered.rule: Header: complete and only policy, no amendment applies; tool API governs names
1. Address the customer as title plus last name
2. arrears, overdue, facility, payment not said before verification
3. Ask once more, then no_customer / not_sure
3. Third party: ask when the holder can be reached
4. Callback today or next business day, 11:00-16:30 inclusive, after now
4. Ask once for another time, then no_customer / no_time
5. Four questions in order: DOB (mdy, YYYY-MM-DD), postcode, phone last 4, founded year
5. Three wrong answers across the whole check; API reports checks remaining
5. On exhaustion "Please contact our business desk." id_failed / no_match
5. Explain once, second refusal id_failed / would_not_answer
6. State every facility before asking anything
8. 1-20 days: end_of_month calendar following, one attempt
8. Promise date today or later, business day, not after deadline; roll forward; after deadline offer deadline; vague ask once then deadline
9. Full first, never ask how much
9. "Can you settle everything today?" once for the batch
9. Attempt 1 full (or floor) on last business day this/next week; attempt 2 floor on deadline
10. One promise per facility; amend reply
11. Hardship: offer hardship_relief transfer, else note hardship
11. Request a person: ask once, then front_desk queue, moved_across / person
12. Own band and attempts per facility; get_account order
12. add_note per unpromised facility, reasons list
12. No notes on a transferred call
12. Recorded promises stay when a transfer follows
12. Single date after one deadline clamped per facility

fixed: phrases.opening_verbatim: was missing (default false), set to true because section 2 says 'The first sentence is exactly'.
outcomes.table[].when: the id_failed and no_customer descriptions were made up, so they are now empty. The moved_across description now quotes section 13 instead of an invented phrase.
source_docs: removed the tool API file. The task lists only the brief as a source document; the API is the separate enum reference.
phrases.source and amounts.source: added the debt_intro, today_question and below-floor sentences so every phrase value has a quoted origin.
unresolved: added days_overdue_outside_bands, because section 8 covers only 1-45 days overdue.
unresolved: added facility_id_vs_product_id, because get_account returns facility_id while create_promise and add_note take product_id.
unresolved: How to read a date without a month or year (calendar.missing_date_parts left as 'unresolved').
Whether asking why the security questions are needed counts as a refusal (left at default true).
Which no_promise reason to use when facilities end with different note reasons (left at default: first non-paid note).
Hardship sympathy sentence: 'one short sentence of sympathy', no verbatim text given.
Section 11 refuse-to-talk sentence is garbled. Read as no_promise/turned_down after verification and id_failed/would_not_answer before it.
No band for facilities 0 days or more than 45 days overdue.
API get_account summary says 'both questions' while the brief requires four. The brief governs.
facility_id (get_account) vs product_id (create_promise/add_note) naming. The brief says to use the facility's id.
The transfer_to_agent enum contains both 'person' and 'front_desk'. The brief names the front-desk queue for a person request, so front_desk is used and 'person' is only the close reason.
